# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 11 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 11 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**11:1** I thank You, O Lord, for You have dealt wondrously with dust, and with a vessel of clay You have shown great power.

**11:2** And what am I? I was taken from dust and fashioned from clay. I was shaped as a fountain of impurity and shameful nakedness,

**11:3** a heap of dust mixed with water, a dwelling of darkness, a figure of clay that returns to dust

**11:4** at the appointed time, along the path all dust must travel. What shall the clay answer, even that which is shaped by hand?

**11:5** What understanding shall it attain? You have dealt wondrously with dust, and with a creature of clay You have shown great power.

**11:6** How shall one born of woman be accounted before You? Kneaded from dust, his dwelling is the food of worms.

**11:7** He is molded clay, and to dust he yearns to return. What shall the clay answer, the work of the hand?

**11:8** What understanding shall it attain?

**11:9** Yet You -- You have placed thanksgiving in my mouth and praise upon my tongue, and my lips overflow with rejoicing,

**11:10** and I shall sing Your covenant-faithfulness and Your power all the day long; continually I shall bless Your name.

**11:11** I shall declare Your glory among the children of men, and in the abundance of Your goodness my soul delights.

**11:12** I know that truth is in Your mouth, righteousness in Your hand, all knowledge in Your purpose,

**11:13** all power in Your strength, and every glory is Yours.

**11:14** In Your anger come all afflicting judgments, yet in Your goodness is abundance of forgiveness,

**11:15** and Your mercies extend to all the children of Your favor.

**11:16** For You have caused them to know the counsel of Your truth and given them insight into Your wondrous mysteries.

**11:17** For Your glory's sake You have cleansed a mortal from transgression, that he may consecrate himself

**11:18** before You from every foul abomination and every guilt of faithlessness, to be joined

**11:19** with the children of Your truth and in the lot of Your holy ones -- raising the worm of the dead from the dust

**11:20** to the everlasting assembly, and from a perverse spirit to Your understanding,

**11:21** that he may stand before You with the everlasting host and the spirits of knowledge,

**11:22** to be renewed with all that is and shall be, with those who know in a shared rejoicing.

**11:23** What is flesh compared to this? What creature of clay can work wonders?

**11:24** He dwells in iniquity from the womb and until old age in the guilt of faithlessness.

**11:25** I know that righteousness does not belong to a mortal, nor the perfect way to any son of man;

**11:26** to God Most High belong all righteous deeds, and the way of a mortal is not established

**11:27** except by the spirit God has formed for him, to perfect a way for the children of men,

**11:28** so that all His works may know the power of His might and the abundance of His mercies

**11:29** toward all the children of His favor.

**11:30** As for me, trembling and shaking seized me, all my bones shattered,

**11:31** my heart melted like wax before fire, my knees gave way like water poured down a slope,

**11:32** when I remembered my guilt and the faithlessness of my fathers, when the wicked rose against Your covenant

**11:33** and the worthless against Your word. I said: On account of my transgression

**11:34** I am cut off from Your covenant. But when I remembered the power of Your hand and the abundance of Your mercies,

**11:35** I gathered strength. I rose, and my spirit held firm against the onslaught,

**11:36** for I leaned upon Your covenant-faithfulness and the abundance of Your mercies. For You atone for iniquity

**11:37** and cleanse a mortal from guilt through Your righteousness.

---
*SOPHIA notes: Column 11 is well preserved. SOPHIA adopted EMET's "covenant-faithfulness" for hesed (over LOGOS's "lovingkindness" and PNEUMA's "faithful love") for consistency with the project's established convention. "Children of Your favor" preferred over PNEUMA's simplified "those He has chosen." The clay/dust anthropology is central to Qumran theology and all three translators rendered it effectively. See disagreement log for 8 divergences.*
